prompt: The endpoint that exchanges an internally-issued token for a user's GitHub access credential accepts any validly-signed token for that account. That means a read-only or otherwise low-privilege token can be redeemed for the user's full GitHub credential, a privilege escalation. Restrict the exchange to only the credential shape that legitimately needs it, without breaking the one existing caller that already holds a write-capable token. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: github access token exchange subject scope
why does github-access-token STS skip audience check
STS confused deputy github credential upgrade
repo scoped token redeem github oauth
